title.en: Claude helped flood Anthropic with30,000 daily merges. Git was replaced.
title.zh: Claude催出每天三万次合并，Anthropic换掉Git。

summary.en: Anthropic reports a five-month internal migration to Scion. More code is not independent proof of better code.
summary.zh: Anthropic披露五个月内部迁移至Scion，代码增量并非质量独立证明。

title.en: Before SpaceX takes Griffin to the Moon, NASA blasted it with153decibels.
title.zh: SpaceX送它登月前，NASA先用153分贝轰它。

summary.en: Griffin-1 passed ground environmental tests. Launch later this year remains planned; a lunar landing is not yet achieved.
summary.zh: Griffin-1通过地面环境测试，今年稍后发射仍为计划，尚未登月。
